title: Beauty Video Templates for Products | AIVideosUGC
description: Pick a beauty video template, drop in your own product, and download a clip with the frame and the voice already set. Skip a blank timeline and post it.
h1: Beauty Video Templates for the Product You Sell
lead: Upload a side-view photo that shows the buttons and the USB-C port, and download a square for the listing. Repeat with the next side when you want another image.

steps.d: The set matches because the layout keeps one shared backdrop. Name the side first: front, buttons, or the face that shows the USB-C port.
Say which side this photo is, such as the front, the buttons, or the USB-C port. The layout keeps that side on one shared backdrop.
Save the square, then move to the speaker's next side. The next side is ready for a short ad with script, spoken voice, and captions.

faq.q: What does the side-view template include for me to download?
faq.a: You get one square photo for each side you upload, with the crop already set. Use the side that shows the buttons or the USB-C port, and download that photo. A spoken line can be added later if you also make a short ad.

faq.q: How do I get a square photo of each side of the speaker?
faq.a: You get one square per side you upload. Start with the speaker's port side, keep the backdrop, and download that square before you do the front. A product link can supply words for a short ad, and your software can start the next side through the API.

faq.q: Why use the speaker photo instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: The speaker photo you already have is enough for this listing. A second opening line for that ad can be cut without calling a crew back in.

faq.q: Who is the side-view template for?
faq.a: Shops and listing managers who need a square photo of each side, starting with this speaker. A person on screen, if you add one, is an AI avatar. Beginners can start from one clear photo.

faq.q: Can I start from one photo if I have never filmed?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear photo of each side. You do not need a turntable. If you also make a video, set captions, a song, and an AI voice in the editor.

faq.q: Which products can I drop into the side-view template?
faq.a: It fits products you already photograph from the side, starting with this speaker. Open another card in the gallery when you want a food or fitness video instead.

faq.q: Can I start from speaker photos and clips I already shot?
faq.a: Yes. Bring a JPG, PNG, or WebP that shows the whole speaker, including the port and the wrist strap. A short clip you have the rights to can come in when the ad needs motion you already filmed.

faq.q: Where can I post these square photos and videos?
faq.a: Each photo is square. A video from the same speaker photos can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. A tall file fits a TikTok placement. A square fits a Facebook feed. YouTube can take the wide file, and Instagram can take the download. You can also post it yourself.

faq.q: Can I use the side-view template without spending credits?
faq.a: No. Each product photo spends 24 credits. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the number first. If it fails, those credits come back. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I post these files in paid ads and listings?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have nothing stamped on them, so you can use them in listings, paid ads, and work you deliver for a client.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of a blank ad?
faq.a: The size and the crop are already chosen. You add the side photo, check the words, and download. You do not build the ad from a blank file.

faq.q: Can one speaker photo show a USB-C port that was hidden?
faq.a: No. Photograph that side and upload it. A made-up view is not a safe way to show a USB-C port, button, or wrist strap that was not in the photo.

steps.prompt: Front and back of the speaker on one plain background, with the port left as it was photographed.
